title: Chance-constrained selection of sequential intervention strategies from counterfactual estimates
abstract: arXiv:2608.13209v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many operational decisions are sequences of interventions under a cumulative resource limit, such as a maintenance schedule within a crew-hour budget. Choosing among them calls for the outcome and the cumulative cost each would produce, counterfactual quantities identified from observational data. Two strategies with the same expected cost can exceed the budget at very different rates, so constraining the mean does not bound how often an overrun occurs. Prior two-step architectures, recently extended to continuous doses, constrain the mean cost rather than its tail and allocate at a single decision point. Methods that do bound a cost tail take its distribution from a specified model rather than identifying it from data. We present a predict-then-optimize framework. translated_title: 基于反事实估计的序贯干预策略的机会约束选择
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13209v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：许多运营决策是在累积资源限制下的干预序列，例如在船员工时预算内的维护计划。选择这些策略需要预测其结果和累积成本，这些是从观测数据中识别的反事实量。两种具有相同预期成本的策略可能在超出预算的频率上差异很大，因此仅约束平均值并不能限制超支发生的次数。先前两步架构（最近扩展到连续剂量）约束平均成本而非其尾部，并在单一决策点进行分配。那些确实约束成本尾部的方法则从指定模型中获取其分布，而非从数据中识别。我们提出一个预测-然后-优化的框架。在预测步骤中，任何返回结果值和成本分布的估计器都能为决策规则提供输入，因此预测器是可互换的。在优化步骤中，我们通过机会约束选择序贯策略，该约束直接限制成本超支的概率，从而在资源限制下平衡结果优化。
tldr: 本文提出一个预测-然后-优化框架，通过机会约束直接限制序贯干预策略的累积成本超支概率，而非仅约束均值，从而在资源限制下更稳健地优化结果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a predict-then-optimize framework that uses chance constraints to directly bound the probability of cumulative cost overruns in sequential intervention strategies, rather than constraining only the mean, enabling more robust outcome optimization under resource limits.
